decisions.reason: Authentication and identity delegation still fits the firm's integrated GeoIT offer, but after two years management would compare its results against aspirations and may drop it if overlap with other identity services keeps performance below target.

The open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's platform-based, customizable solution strategy, so even under bounded rationality it is likely to be retained unless results clearly disappoint.

The GIS-specific identity and access service remains strategically complementary, yet with both C and E in the portfolio management would monitor comparative performance closely and could rationalize the weaker of the two if returns fall short of aspirations.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's established consulting capabilities and likely needs more time to prove itself, so available organizational slack supports retention unless demand is clearly too weak.
